name: benchmark-longmemsmallchat
description: Benchmark that evaluates conversational models' ability to maintain and use long-term context (memory) in small-scale chat settings. It contains dialogues that require recalling information from many turns earlier and producing coherent, context-aware responses. The benchmark measures both factual recall across long contexts and the quality/coherence of generated replies.
reputation: A small, experimental dataset used by researchers testing long-context/chat capabilities; limited broad adoption.
